title: Cain Murders Abel
summary: Cain, the firstborn of Adam and Eve, kills his brother Abel; God marks Cain, who goes to the land of Nod. Seth is later given "instead of Abel".
description: Genesis 4. Abel is commended in Heb 11:4.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals: Before 130 AM / 3874 BC; "man had been on the earth 128 years" at the murder (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.
Eve names Seth as given "instead of Abel, whom Cain slew"; Adam was 130 at Seth's birth. year_am is the latest possible year.

chronologies.date: Before 130 AM / 3874 BC; "man had been on the earth 128 years" at the murder
chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, First Age, §13 (under heading 130 AM, 840 JP, 3874 BC)
chronologies.note: Ussher's wording implies ~AM 128-129 but gives no separate year heading.

chronologies.date: "125? - Cain kills Abel" ("most likely shortly before am 130")
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §4 "The Chronology of Genesis 4 & 5" (year list)
chronologies.note: Question mark is Jordan's. Pentateuch Part 1 (BC 6:3) §3 "The Sacrifice of Abel": "it was most likely shortly before am 130, because Seth was born soon after", in the autumn ("at the end of days").

open_questions: Cain and Abel have no person records yet (outside the Gen 5 line); add if desired.
